title: 2 CFR 200.329 Monitoring and reporting program performance (eCFR)
note: Federal floor for all federal awards: periodic performance reports relating accomplishments to award objectives, no less than annually; final report within 120 days. Does not require baselines, outcome measurement, or independent verification. Source 89 FR 30136 (Apr. 22, 2024).

title: 2 CFR 200.301 Performance measurement (eCFR)
note: Agencies must measure performance; specifying outcomes, indicators, targets and baseline data in the award is recommended (should), not required.

title: NYS Office of the State Comptroller, New York State's Clean Energy Fund (July 2024)
note: Reports Clean Energy Fund progress as acquired versus committed savings (23.9 TBtu acquired through Dec. 2023, 45 percent of the 2025 goal). Does not assess whether reported savings are estimated or independently verified.
